title: DEIG-Einsatz – Festnahme nach Hausfriedensbruch, Sachbeschädigung und Widerstand gegen Vollstreckungsbeamte

extraction.summaryEn: Police were called to a person behaving erratically on a roof, who then entered a flat under renovation and barricaded himself in a bathroom. He was subdued with a stun device, arrested and taken to hospital; charges include trespassing, property damage and resisting officers.
